node.title: Re^3: Printing an array using while loop
node.author: haukex
node.doctext:
put handles <> on your array: while(my $item = <@array>) { print("$item\n"); }

Although this works in this particular case, I wouldn't recommend it: The <> actually doesn't do anything with "handles" (like <$filehandle>, which is [doc://readline]), instead it's [doc://glob] in disguise, and [id://1206848|glob has several caveats]. I would suggest a regular [doc://perlsyn#Foreach-Loops|foreach], or perhaps [doc://each] (Perl >= 5.12, which was not available in 2007, at the time of this thread).

$ perl -MO=Deparse -e 'while(my $item = <@array>) { print "$item\n" }' while (defined(my $item = glob(join $", @array))) { do { use File::Glob (); print "$item\n" }; }
